v1_1_1.new_0: Release notes shown on every new version
v1_1_1.perf_0: Large music libraries load much faster
v1_1_1.perf_1: Album artwork loads gradually as you scroll
v1_1_1.perf_2: Progress bar while track information is loading

v1_1_0.new_0: Track information (title, artist, album, duration) now displays automatically
v1_1_0.new_1: Album artwork shown in full on track cards, with duration overlaid
v1_1_0.new_2: Text stays readable even on tracks with light-coloured artwork

v1_0_51.new_0: Built-in dialogs, no more browser popups
v1_0_51.new_1: Visual notifications for confirmations and action feedback
v1_0_51.new_3: Persistent mini-player with artwork, artist name and volume control
v1_0_51.new_4: Customisable colour per music folder via right-click
v1_0_51.new_5: Drag and drop tracks between folders
v1_0_51.change_0: Track durations stay visible when navigating between pages
v1_0_51.change_1: Sort tracks by name, duration or file type

v1_0_0.new_0: Game library with automatic detection of Steam, Epic Games and Battle.net
v1_0_0.new_1: Built-in music player with folder management
v1_0_0.new_3: Customisable background image and accent colour
v1_0_0.new_4: Automatic launch of ArcHive on Windows startup
v1_0_0.new_5: Minimise to system tray when closing the window
